note: Export side is factually confirmed by customs bill-of-lading records with dates, destination (Jebel Ali, UAE; also Nepal lane), HS codes and BOL numbers — not merely a website claim. Declared HS 120241/120242 (groundnuts) matches the observed export line HS 12024210 (raw peanut bold 50/60), so the declared code is consistent with actual shipments; note the same exporter also ships HS 10059011 (yellow maize) and 07132010 (chick peas), so the product range is broader than the declared HS pair. Caveat on identity: 'SATYAM TRADERS' is a very common Indian trade name and the ImportKey free view mixes several counterparties under this name (supplier lists include MARUTI TRADING COMPANY, SUBHAN INTERNATIONAL, YONGKANG JIAJING; buyer list includes HOPES & BENNETT GENERAL TRADING LLC, BHANU ENTERPRISES), so the 436-record counter cannot be attributed with certainty to a single legal entity — no CIN/PAN/GSTIN is shown on the page and none was claimed, so legal-entity linkage remains unverified. Second sources (volza, eximpedia, trademo) returned HTTP 403 and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable during this run, so cross-confirmation is limited to the single ImportKey source. Domestic supply evidence: none found — stated plainly, not softened. No rejection grounds: entity is not shown as non-existent, struck off or bankrupt.
